# Library/find_record

Say whether a book or a member goes by a name, and name each match.

Source: `_commands/Library/find_record.py`.

Calls: `Library/find_book`, `Library/find_member`.
Depth: 1 (lower bound; open steps name no command)

## Inputs

| input | type | default | sample | classifier_confirms / classifier_decides | copied_from_command_text / record_named_in_command_text | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | str | required | `<name>` |  | yes | the name to look for |
| `kind` | one of book, member | `book` | `book` |  |  | whether to look for a book or a member |

- `name` must be written in the command text (`copied_from_command_text`).

## Example requests

- do you have a book called Emma
- is there a member named Lee
- do we have any member called Patel
- is there a book called Dune Messiah
- does anyone go by the name Mia
- is a title called Persuasion in the catalogue
- is there a patron named Raj
- check whether we have a book titled Dune and name the matches
